newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Mayor Daley proposes $150 mln program.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Mayor Daley proposes $150 mln program.

text.p: Chicago Mayor Richard Daley on Tuesday said a $150 million capital program for 1997 will be funded in part with bond proceeds by the Chicago Skyway.

The program, called the Great Neighborhoods program, will be funded in part with $50 million of Skway bond sale proceeds, rebating the city for previous loans and improvements to the Skyway, Daley said.

"For many years, the Chicago Skyway was a drain on city finances," Mayor Daley said. "Today, it is a symbol of success and good management. Instead of city spending to keep the Skyway operating, the Skyway is now helping to fund transportation improvement all across Chicago."
